description: fetchngs writes a metatdenovo samplesheet (sample, fastq_1, fastq_2) with --nf-core-pipeline metatdenovo. Runs whose ENA instrument_platform is not a short-read platform (the ones nf-core/mag accepts as short reads: ILLUMINA, BGISEQ, DNBSEQ, ELEMENT, ULTIMA, ION_TORRENT, LS454, …) are refused: metatdenovo analyses short reads, and long-read, capillary or colour-space runs would be processed as if they were.
